newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: EU to attend Middle East peace meeting.
newsitem.headline: EU to attend Middle East peace meeting.

text.p: The European Union said on Thursday it had accepted an invitation from Palestinian President Yasser Arafat to attend a meeting in Gaza on Saturday on the fragile Middle East peace process.

"The presidency (of the EU) has accepted the invitation by President Arafat and will be represented by the presidency's local representative," the EU said in a statement issued by the Netherlands, which currently holds the bloc's presidency.
The statement did not say who else would attend the meeting.

"The European Union remains firmly of the view that the peace process is the only path to security and peace for the Palestinians as well as for Israel. The European Union is concerned about the latest developments in the peace process since the agreement reached on Hebron," said the statement.

The EU's special envoy for the Middle East peace process, Ambassador Miguel Moratinos, would return to the region this weekend in order to discuss with the parties a number of European ideas, it added.
"The European Union confirms its readiness to assist in every way possible efforts to promote a just and durable peace in the Middle East," said the statement.
